en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large 19th‑century, multi‑storey masonry building in an eclectic / neo‑Renaissance style, probably a railway station or major public building. It has a prominent corner block with gabled roof and battlement‑like details, long side wings with repetitive tall windows, and a tower visible further along the façade. In front are a wide paved area, horse‑drawn carriages, and a few pedestrians, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban scene. The image has the typical framing and border damage of an old photographic postcard. No visible printed text or caption can be seen on the image side.
